title: Set 150

sentences.ko: 마음이 좀 편해질 것 같아서 도자기 수업에 등록했는데, 만드는 것마다 다 삐뚤빼뚤하게 나와서 몇 주 다니다가 그냥 안 나갔어. 근데 사실 아직도 수업료가 빠져나가고 있는 것 같아.
sentences.text: I signed up for a pottery class because I thought it'd be relaxing, but everything I made came out lopsided, so after a few weeks I just stopped going. And I think I'm still getting charged for it, actually.

alts.text: Took a pottery class since I figured it'd be chill, but all my stuff came out crooked, so I quit after a few weeks. Pretty sure they're still charging me for it, too.

I enrolled in a pottery class because I believed it would be relaxing, but everything I made came out uneven, so after a few weeks I stopped attending. In fact, I believe I am still being charged for it.

sentences.note: **came out lopsided** 는 만든 결과물이 한쪽으로 기울어 삐뚤게 나왔다는 뜻입니다. **getting charged for** 는 무엇의 요금이 계속 청구되고 있다는 말로, 끝에 붙은 **actually** 가 말하다 생각난 사실을 덧붙이는 느낌을 줍니다.

sentences.ko: 앉을 데를 찾아서 카페를 세 군데나 가 봤는데, 가는 데마다 노트북 하는 사람들로 꽉 차 있어서 결국 차에서 커피를 마셨어.
sentences.text: We tried three different coffee shops looking for somewhere to sit, and every single one was full of people on laptops, so we ended up drinking our coffee in the car.

alts.text: Hit up three coffee shops looking for a seat, and they were all packed with laptop people, so we just drank it in the car.
We visited three different coffee shops in search of a place to sit, and each one was full of people working on laptops, so we ultimately drank our coffee in the car.

sentences.note: **ended up** 은 계획한 건 아닌데 어쩌다 보니 결국 그렇게 됐다는 뜻입니다. **every single one** 은 every one 을 강조해서 하나도 빠짐없이 전부라는 느낌을 줍니다.

sentences.ko: 솔직히 어디로 가든 상관없어. 그냥 금요일까지 날짜만 정해 주면 돼. 그 뒤로는 우리 상사가 아무것도 결재를 안 해 주거든. 그러니까 너 회사에 한번 알아보고 알려 줄래?
sentences.text: Honestly, I don't care where we go, I just need the dates by Friday, because my boss won't sign off on anything after that. So can you check with your work and let me know?

alts.text: Don't care where we go, just need dates by Friday 'cause my boss won't okay anything after that. Can you check at work and get back to me?
To be candid, I have no preference as to where we go, but I need the dates by Friday, as my manager will not approve anything after that. Could you please check with your employer and let me know?

sentences.note: **sign off on** 은 윗사람이 무언가를 승인하거나 결재해 준다는 뜻입니다. **check with** 는 누구에게 먼저 물어보고 확인한다는 말이라 여기서는 네 회사에 확인해 보라는 뜻이 됩니다.

sentences.ko: 네가 말해 준 그 태국 음식점 드디어 가 봤어. 네 말대로 음식은 진짜 맛있었는데, 자리 나기까지 거의 한 시간을 기다려서 토요일에 또 갈지는 모르겠어.
sentences.text: So we finally tried that Thai place you told us about. You were right, the food was really good, but we waited almost an hour for a table, so I don't know if I'd go back on a Saturday.

alts.text: Finally hit that Thai spot you mentioned. Food was great, you were right, but we waited almost an hour for a table, so not sure I'd go back on a Saturday.
We finally visited the Thai restaurant you recommended. You were correct that the food was excellent, but we waited nearly an hour for a table, so I am not certain I would return on a Saturday.

sentences.note: **You were right** 는 상대가 한 말이 맞았다고 인정할 때 흔히 쓰는 말입니다. **I don't know if I'd go back** 은 다시 갈지 잘 모르겠다며 부드럽게 망설임을 나타냅니다.
sentences.situation: 친구가 추천한 식당 다녀와서 후기 말하기

sentences.ko: 같은 책을 네 번이나 읽어 줬는데, 방에서 나가려고만 하면 물 달라, 한 번 더 안아 달라 그러는 거야. 그래서 겨우 잠들었을 때는 너무 지쳐서 오늘 밤에 하려던 일을 하나도 못 했어.
sentences.text: I read her the same book four times, and every time I tried to leave she wanted water or another hug. So by the time she finally fell asleep, I was too tired to do any of the stuff I wanted to get done tonight.

alts.text: Same book four times, and every time I got up she wanted water or another hug. By the time she conked out I was way too wiped to get anything done tonight.

I read her the same book four times, and each time I attempted to leave, she asked for water or another hug. By the time she finally fell asleep, I was too exhausted to do any of the things I had intended to accomplish this evening.

sentences.note: **by the time** 은 어떤 일이 일어났을 때쯤에는 이미 다른 일이 벌어져 있었다는 뜻입니다. **too tired to** 는 너무 지쳐서 무엇을 할 수 없었다는 말이고, casual 의 **conked out** 은 곯아떨어졌다는 뜻입니다.

reviewed: 2번 casual 의 Hit up three coffee shops for a seat 는 for a seat 가 어색해서 looking for a seat 로 고쳤고, 뒷부분도 더 짧은 구어로 바꿨습니다
3번 casual 앞부분이 text 와 거의 같아서 주어를 빼고 get back to me 로 줄여 차이를 냈습니다
3번 formal 의 check with your workplace 는 원어민이 쓰지 않는 말이라 check with your employer 로 고쳤습니다
4번 casual 이 text 처럼 We finally 로 시작해서 주어를 뺐고, 한국어 너가 를 네가 로 고쳤습니다
5번 casual 첫 마디가 text 와 거의 같아서 Same book four times 로 시작하는 짧은 구어로 새로 썼습니다
